title: Check Project Stack Health and Tool Status
trigger: User wants to verify that all project tools and dependencies are properly configured

steps.action: Look at the switcher bar to spot the health badge if any tools are not well; it is a warning triangle with a count
Click the health badge to open a list of tools with status issues (needs update, not tracked, not installed)
The list shows which tools are missing, need updates, or are out of sync with kaava.toml
Use a terminal to clone or pull the tool repositories as needed to resolve the issues

outcome: The stack health badge shows the status of any pinned tools, indicating if updates or installations are needed
